simple.meaning: זֶרַע (zeraʻ) appears 229 times in the Hebrew Scriptures as a person-name in the Hebrew text. The surrounding account also brings the name into death.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, beginning at Genesis 1:11. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as birth, family line, death, covenant.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to זֶרַע (H2233) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows זֶרַע through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: זֶרַע (zeraʻ) / H2233 is tracked through Genesis 1:11, Genesis 1:12, Genesis 1:29, Genesis 3:15. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.

definitions.full: H2233. zera זֶ֫רַע noun masculine Deut 28:38 sowing, seed, offspring (Late Hebrew id. , Aramaic זְרַע , ; Phoenician זרע ; Zinjirli id. ; Arabic seed-produce, seed ; Ethiopic Assyrian zêru , cultivated land , Belser BAS ii. 130, compare Arabic ) — absolute ׳ז Gen 47:23 =; זָ֑רַע 1:29 +; construct זֶרַע Isa 5:10 +; זְרַעֿ Num 11:7 ; suffix זַרְעִי 1Sam 20:42 ; 24:22 ; זַרְעֲךָ Deut 11:10 +; זַרְעֶ֑ךָ Eccl 11:6 +; etc.; plural suffix זַרְעֵיכֶם 1Sam 8:15 ; — 1 literal: a. a sowing ׳לְז הַשָּׂדֶה Gen 47:24 (J; + אָכְלְכֶם ; otherwise Lev 27:16 b, see below 2c ); ז מְקוֺם ׳לֹא Num 20:5 no place for sowing (J E; + וְרִמּוֺן וְגֶפֶן וּתְאֵנָה ); compare ז ׳שְׂדֵה Ezek 17:5 a field suitable for sowing ; hence b. sowing as regularly recurring at its season Gen 8:22 (J; || קָצִיר , + וָלַיְלָה וְיוֺם וָחֹרֶף וְקַיִץ וָחֹם קֹר ), Lev 26:5 (H; || בָּצִיר דַּיִשׁ, ; — compare Amos 9:13 below 2a ). 2 seed: a. literally, sown, to raise crops for food, usually corn (wheat, barely, etc.) Gen 47:19 , 23 (J; compare 47:14 f.), Num 24:7 (JE); ׳ז לַֹזּרֵעַ נָתַן Isa 55:10 (|| לֶחֶם ), Deut 28:38 ( ׳ז רַב ), Lev 26:16 (H; with זָרַע ), 27:16 a, ׳ז שְׂעֹרִים חֹמֶר 27:16 b (both P), compare Isa 5:10 . b. figurative, of idolatry of Judah Isa 17:11 (|| קציר ); of fortunes of Zion הַזּ ׳מֶשֶׁךְ Psa 126:6 the dropping of seed , i.e. the proper quantity for sowing (opposed to אֲלֻמֹּת ); Jer 35:7 (with זָרַע , || תִטָּ֔עוּ לֹא כֶּרֶם ), compare 35:9 (|| שׂדה כרם, ); ז ׳מְטַר Isa 30:23 (with זָרַע , || הָאֲדָמָה תְּבוּאַתּ לֶחֶם ); also Deut 11:10 (with זָרַע ), Eccl 11:6 (c. id. ); ׳ז זֵרוּעַ Lev 11:37 , compare 11:38 (both P); as yielding the crop זַרְעֶ֑ךָ תְּבוּאַת Deut 14:22 the product of thy seed , compare d. below; הַזּ בְּמשֵׁךְ עֲנָבִים וְדֹרֵךְ בַּקּוֺצֵר תוֺרֵשׁ ׳וְנִגַּשׁ Amos 9:13 , in figure of rapid and plentiful growth in the coming time; ׳ז הָאָרֶץ producing a vine Ezek 17:5 , of growth and prosperity of Israel; ׳הַזּ Mal 2:3 , read perhaps הַזְּרֹעַ (compare VB). c. seed as product; the manna is compare with ׳ז גַּד , coriander seed Num 11:7 (JE), Exod 16:31 (P); seed of herbs and trees Gen 1:11 (twice in verse); 1:12 (twice in verse); 1:29 (twice in verse) (all P).
